note: Set-up: white side up, diamond. Source: https://origami.me/dove/
1: Fold the lower tip upward. The text says unfold, but diagrams 1–2 require the folded triangle; follow the diagrams.
2: Fold the left corner to the right corner.
3: Fold the front triangular packet upward.
4: Pinch the left edge midpoint of the front flap; mark length 0.07 sheet units.
5: Precrease the front flap tip onto the midpoint pinch.
6: Inside-reverse both nested flap pairs together into their own pockets.
7: Turn over.
8a: Repeat the front triangular packet fold on the back.
8b: Repeat the midpoint pinch, 0.07 sheet units long.
8c: Precrease the back tip to its midpoint mark.
8d: Reverse the two nested pairs on the back.
9: Turn over from bottom to top.
10: Precrease the beak. Free proportion: hinge from 10% along the upper diagonal to the right-edge midpoint.
11: Inside reverse the beak on the prepared crease.
12: Lift the first wing along the upper diagonal.
13a: Turn over to reach the second wing.
13b: Lift the second wing along its matching upper diagonal.
13c: Return to the first side.
14: Precrease the tail edge onto the diagonal body boundary.
15: Precrease the tail on the diagonal body boundary.
16: Crimp the tail flat on its two prepared boundary-meeting hinges.
Presentation: rotate counterclockwise 70 degrees as shown in the tutorial.
